30-day money-back guarantee

Your satisfaction is our top priority and we're confident you'll be pleased with our services. Still, if you try us and decide your account does not sufficiently meet your needs, you can cancel within 30 days for a refund as follows:

  • If you cancel within 30 days you'll receive a full refund on Hosting and/or Solutions attached to your account. The money-back guarantee does not apply to most add-on products, such as domains, given the unique nature of their costs.
  • If you cancel within 30 days and your plan includes a free domain, there will be a fee to retain that domain. Bluehost will deduct a non-refundable domain fee from your refund, at the regular cost of your domain.
  • Bluehost does not offer any refunds for cancellations that occur after 30 days.

Free Domain Policy

One free domain is included for one year with the purchase of a web hosting plan of 12 or 36 month terms. This free domain must be redeemed within 90 days from date of purchase. Free domain is only applicable on either a domain transfer into Bluehost or a new domain purchase of one the following TLD’s: .BIZ, .INFO, .COM, .NET, .ORG, .UK, .CO.UK, .US, .EU, .DE, .NL, .CO, .SPACE, .WEBSITE, .BLOG, .ONLINE, .SITE, .STORE, .TECH. Premium domain names excluded from this offer.

After the first year, the domain will automatically renew at the then current rate (located in your renewal center) until cancelled, you can cancel at any time. However, please note that newly registered domains cannot be transferred to another registrar during your first sixty days of a registration period. Any domains cancelled within the 1st year of service will be assessed a non-refundable domain fee based on the standard cost for the domain, plus any other applicable fees. Please see the Domain Registration Agreement for more details.

acceptedAnswer.text: There are four main types of web hosting: Dedicated Hosting, Web Hosting, Cloud Hosting and VPS Hosting. Dedicated hosting provides a server solely for one user; web hosting allows multiple users to share one server; cloud hosting is powered by a redundant global server infrastructure to handle high traffic; VPS hosting is a hybrid of web hosting and dedicated hosting. Each web hosting option has its own benefits and drawbacks, and the choice depends on the specific needs of the website.

<section>
<p>The <strong>AI Action Plan</strong> of the <a href="https://www.bluehost.com/ai-store" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Bluehost AI Store</a> helps you identify and prioritize opportunities to improve your online store's visibility, product quality, sales performance, and channel reach. Powered by multiple AI agents, this feature analyzes your store data and generates actionable recommendations that can help optimize your store's performance.</p>

<p>This article explains where to find the AI Action Plan in your AI Store dashboard and how to analyze the recommendations it provides. It also includes a video walkthrough for additional guidance.</p>

<div class="video-container"><iframe allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen" frameborder="0" height="150" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/r7hXP8jJjIU?si=G24oGbgcFpDuF8tf?rel=0" title="Bluehost AI Store to Grow Your Online Business" width="300"></iframe></div>
</section>

<p> </p>

<section data-content-status="current" data-interface-context="bluehost-portal" data-product-context="bluehost-ai-all-access" data-solution-type="primary">
<h2 id="where-to-find-ai-action-plan">Where Can I Find the AI Action Plan?</h2>

<p>You can access AI recommendations from the AI Store through either of the following locations:</p>

<ul>
	<li>The <strong>AI Action Plan</strong> widget on the <strong>Dashboard</strong></li>
	<li>The <strong>Merchant Command Center</strong> in the <strong>AI Insights</strong> tab</li>
</ul>

<p>For more information, please visit the <a href="https://www.bluehost.com/help/article/bh-ai-store-insights-tab" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Bluehost AI Store: AI Insights Tab</a> plan.</p>

<p>To view the complete AI Action Plan:</p>
<style type="text/css">.img-responsive {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
</style>
<ol>
	<li>Log in to your <a href="https://www.bluehost.com/my-account/login" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Bluehost Portal</a>.</li>
	<li>From the left-hand menu, click the <strong>Websites</strong> tab.
	<p><img alt="Bluehost Portal - Websites tab" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/ai-products/bh-ai-store-websites.png" width="200" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
	<li>Locate your <strong>Sell Online</strong> plan. If you have multiple websites, you need to scroll down and click the<strong> Load More</strong> link.
	<p><img alt="Load More link" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/ai-products/bh-ai-store-load-more-link.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
	<li>Click the <strong>Manage Store</strong> button next to your site.
	<p><img alt="Bluehost Portal - Manage Store" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/ai-products/bh-ai-store-manage-store.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
	<li>You will be redirected to your <strong>Bluehost AI Store Dashboard</strong>.
	<p><img alt="Bluehost AI Store Dashboard" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/ai-products/bh-ai-store-dashboard.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
</ol>

<ol start="6">
	<li>In the <strong>Dashboard</strong>, scroll down to the <strong>AI Action Plan</strong> section.

	<p><img alt="AI Store - Dashboard - AI Action Plan" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-dashboard-ai-action-plan.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
	<li>The Dashboard displays a preview of your AI recommendations. To view the full list, click the <strong>Full Command Center</strong> link.
	<p><img alt="Dashboard - AI Action Plan - Full Command Center" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-dashboard-full-command-center.png" width="800" /></p>

	<p>This will take you to the <strong>AI Insights</strong> tab. Alternatively, you can navigate directly to the <strong>AI Insights</strong> tab.</p>

	<p><img alt="AI Store - AI Insights tab" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-insights-tab-action-plan.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
	<li>In <strong>AI Insights</strong>, select the <strong>Action Plan</strong> tab to view the complete list of recommendations.
	<p><img alt="AI Insights tab - Action Plan tab" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-ai-insights-action-plan-tab.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
</ol>
</section>

<section data-content-status="current" data-interface-context="bluehost-portal" data-product-context="bluehost-ai-all-access" data-solution-type="primary">
<h2 id="understanding-ai-action-plan">Understanding the AI Action Plan</h2>

<p>The AI Action Plan highlights the most important recommendations to help you focus on the actions that can have the greatest impact on your store.</p>

<h3 id="action-plan-tab">Action Plan Tab</h3>

<p>The <strong>Action Plan</strong> tab shows all your recommendations organized into three priority groups. Items at the top of the list have the highest urgency and financial impact.</p>

<p><strong>Priority Groups:</strong></p>

<p><img alt="Action Plan - Priority groups" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-ai-insights-priority-groups.png" width="800" /></p>

<ol type="a">
	<li><strong class="GUIDDE-JS-AutoBlurred GUIDDE-JS-AutoBlurred-dates">Do Today</strong> - High-urgency issues actively blocking sales or putting significant revenue at risk. Address these as soon as possible.</li>
	<li><strong>Do This Week</strong> - Important issues that can improve your store's performance and shouldn't wait long.</li>
	<li><strong>Improve When Possible</strong> - Lower-priority optimizations for when you have time.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>What's on each recommendation card?</strong></p>

<p>This card includes the following components:</p>

<p><img alt="Action Plan - Recommendation components" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-ai-insights-recommendation-components2.png" width="800" /></p>

<ol type="a">
	<li><strong>Urgency tag</strong> - Reflects how time-sensitive the issue is (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW).</li>
	<li><strong>Financial impact tag</strong> - The estimated revenue at stake or opportunity value in dollars.</li>
	<li><strong>Category tags</strong> - Indicates which area(s) of your store are affected (e.g., Order, Catalog, Channel, Marketing, Inventory).</li>
	<li><strong>Title and description</strong> - Shows a summary of the issue and why it matters.</li>
	<li><strong>Show action steps</strong> — Click to expand a step-by-step breakdown of what to do.</li>
	<li><strong>Go button</strong> — Takes you directly to the relevant section of your store to fix the issue.</li>
</ol>

<div class="alert alert-warning">Some recommendations are combined into one card when they have the same root cause. For example, a missing product ID and a rejected Google Shopping listing may be grouped together because fixing the product ID can resolve both issues.</div>

<h3 id="action-plan-tab">Agent Reports Tab</h3>

<p>The <strong>Agent Reports</strong> tab shows what each individual AI agent found during its last analysis. This is useful if you want to dig into a specific area of your store — such as catalog health or channel performance — rather than viewing the consolidated action plan.</p>

<p>Here are the seven agents analyzing your store and what they monitor:</p>

<p><img alt="Agent Reports tab" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-agent-reports-tab1.png" width="800" /></p>

<ul>
	<li><strong>Catalog Health Agent</strong> - Product data quality, prices, descriptions, images, and sellability.</li>
	<li><strong>Channel Optimization Agent</strong> - Product listings on Google Shopping, Meta Catalog, and other channels.</li>
	<li><strong>Customer Intelligence Agent</strong> - Customer segments, engagement, and retention opportunities.</li>
	<li><strong>Inventory Forecasting Agent</strong> - Stock levels, stockout risk, and overstock.</li>
	<li><strong>Marketing Automation Agent</strong> - Campaign opportunities and automation gaps.</li>
	<li><strong>Order Intelligence Agent</strong> - Order fulfillment, payment status, and fraud risk.</li>
	<li><strong>Pricing and Promotions Agent</strong> - Pricing gaps and promotional opportunities.</li>
</ul>

<p>Each agent card shows:</p>

<ol type="a">
	<li><strong>Agent name</strong> and number of critical issues found</li>
	<li><strong>Last run time</strong></li>
	<li><strong>Health score</strong> - A 0–100 score for the area the agent monitors (e.g., Catalog Health, Channel Health, Margin Health)</li>
	<li><strong>Urgency indicators</strong> - Overall urgency level for that agent's findings</li>
</ol>

<p>Click the arrow on any agent card to expand it and see its detailed findings, including sub-scores and individual recommendations with direct links to the affected products or orders.</p>
</section>

<section data-content-status="current" data-interface-context="bluehost-portal" data-product-context="bluehost-ai-all-access" data-solution-type="primary">
<h2 id="taking-action-on-recommendation">Taking Action on a Recommendation</h2>

<ol>
	<li>In the <strong>Action Plan</strong> tab, find the recommendation you want to address.</li>
	<li>Click <strong>Show action steps</strong> to see a breakdown of what's involved.</li>
	<li>Click <strong>Go</strong> to navigate directly to the section of your store associated with the issue.
	<p><img alt="Action Plan - Go button" class="img-responsive" src="https://content.bluehost.com/bluehost/img/bh-portal/ai_sites_tab/bh-ai-store-ai-insights-tab-go.png" width="800" /><br />
	 </p>
	</li>
	<li>Complete the recommended task.</li>
</ol>

<p>Once an issue is resolved, it will no longer appear the next time the AI analyzes your store.</p>
</section>

<section>
<h2 id="summary">Summary</h2>

<p>Learn how to access and use the AI Action Plan in the <a href="https://www.bluehost.com/ai-store" target="_blank">Bluehost AI Store</a>. This article explains where to find AI-generated recommendations, how recommendations are prioritized and categorized, and how to take action on identified issues to improve your store's visibility, performance, and overall quality.</p>
</section>

Understanding the AI Action Plan Action Plan Tab Agent Reports Tab Taking Action on a Recommendation Summary The AI Action Plan of the Bluehost AI Store helps you identify and prioritize opportunities to improve your online store's visibility, product quality, sales performance, and channel reach. Powered by multiple AI agents, this feature analyzes your store data and generates actionable recommendations that can help optimize your store's performance. This article explains where to find the AI Action Plan in your AI Store dashboard and how to analyze the recommendations it provides. It also includes a video walkthrough for additional guidance.   Where Can I Find the AI Action Plan? You can access AI recommendations from the AI Store through either of the following locations: The AI Action Plan widget on the Dashboard The Merchant Command Center in the AI Insights tab For more information, please visit the  Bluehost AI Store: AI Insights Tab  plan. To view the complete AI Action Plan: Log in to your Bluehost Portal . From the left-hand menu, click the Websites tab.   Locate your Sell Online plan. If you have multiple websites, you need to scroll down and click the Load More link.   Click the Manage Store button next to your site.   You will be redirected to your Bluehost AI Store Dashboard .   In the Dashboard , scroll down to the AI Action Plan section.   The Dashboard displays a preview of your AI recommendations. To view the full list, click the Full Command Center link. This will take you to the AI Insights tab. Alternatively, you can navigate directly to the AI Insights tab.   In AI Insights , select the Action Plan tab to view the complete list of recommendations.   Understanding the AI Action Plan The AI Action Plan highlights the most important recommendations to help you focus on the actions that can have the greatest impact on your store. Action Plan Tab The Action Plan tab shows all your recommendations organized into three priority groups. Items at the top of the list have the highest urgency and financial impact. Priority Groups: Do Today - High-urgency issues actively blocking sales or putting significant revenue at risk. Address these as soon as possible. Do This Week - Important issues that can improve your store's performance and shouldn't wait long. Improve When Possible - Lower-priority optimizations for when you have time. What's on each recommendation card? This card includes the following components: Urgency tag - Reflects how time-sensitive the issue is (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW). Financial impact tag - The estimated revenue at stake or opportunity value in dollars. Category tags - Indicates which area(s) of your store are affected (e.g., Order, Catalog, Channel, Marketing, Inventory). Title and description - Shows a summary of the issue and why it matters. Show action steps — Click to expand a step-by-step breakdown of what to do. Go button — Takes you directly to the relevant section of your store to fix the issue. Some recommendations are combined into one card when they have the same root cause. For example, a missing product ID and a rejected Google Shopping listing may be grouped together because fixing the product ID can resolve both issues. Agent Reports Tab The Agent Reports tab shows what each individual AI agent found during its last analysis. This is useful if you want to dig into a specific area of your store — such as catalog health or channel performance — rather than viewing the consolidated action plan. Here are the seven agents analyzing your store and what they monitor: Catalog Health Agent - Product data quality, prices, descriptions, images, and sellability. Channel Optimization Agent - Product listings on Google Shopping, Meta Catalog, and other channels. Customer Intelligence Agent - Customer segments, engagement, and retention opportunities. Inventory Forecasting Agent - Stock levels, stockout risk, and overstock. Marketing Automation Agent - Campaign opportunities and automation gaps. Order Intelligence Agent - Order fulfillment, payment status, and fraud risk. Pricing and Promotions Agent - Pricing gaps and promotional opportunities. Each agent card shows: Agent name and number of critical issues found Last run time Health score - A 0–100 score for the area the agent monitors (e.g., Catalog Health, Channel Health, Margin Health) Urgency indicators - Overall urgency level for that agent's findings Click the arrow on any agent card to expand it and see its detailed findings, including sub-scores and individual recommendations with direct links to the affected products or orders. Taking Action on a Recommendation In the Action Plan tab, find the recommendation you want to address. Click Show action steps to see a breakdown of what's involved. Click Go to navigate directly to the section of your store associated with the issue.   Complete the recommended task. Once an issue is resolved, it will no longer appear the next time the AI analyzes your store. Summary Learn how to access and use the AI Action Plan in the Bluehost AI Store . This article explains where to find AI-generated recommendations, how recommendations are prioritized and categorized, and how to take action on identified issues to improve your store's visibility, performance, and overall quality. If you need further assistance, Bluehost Chat Support is available 24 hours a day, 7days a week while Bluehost Phone Support is available 7 days a week from 7 am-12 midnight EST.  Chat Support -  While on our website , you should see a CHAT bubble in the bottom right-hand corner of the page. Click anywhere on the bubble to begin a chat session. Phone Support - US: 888-401-4678 International: +1 801-765-9400 You may also refer to our Knowledge Base articles to help answer common questions and guide you through various setup, configuration, and troubleshooting steps. Usage Policies

How much disk space and bandwidth will my plan include?

For plans supporting "Unmetered" disk space and/or bandwidth, we do not have defined limitations, which means you are not charged according to the amount of disk space or bandwidth you use. While these resources are not infinite, we believe our customers should have all of the resources necessary to build an online presence, and the majority of our customers will have more than enough disk space and bandwidth to meet their needs.

With that being said, all use of hosting space provided by Bluehost is subject to our Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy. Disk space and bandwidth should only be utilized in the normal operation of a personal or small business website.

For example, accounts with an excessive amount of database tables (i.e. in excess of 5,000 database tables) or an excessive database size (i.e. in excess of 10GB total database usage or 5GB database usage in a single database) would be in violation of our Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy. Please see our Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy for more information.

What happens if I exceed usage?

If we have concerns about your account's bandwidth or disk space utilization, you will receive an email to your account on file asking you to reduce usage.

It is very rare for a customer who is managing a personal or small business website to exceed our usage policies, however, Bluehost reserves the right to terminate a Subscriber account, with or without notice, for excessive use of resources that result in degradation of service performance or the Services.

International calling fees may apply FAQs HOW DO I REGISTER THE FREE DOMAIN INCLUDED WITH ANNUAL HOSTING PLANS? You can register your free domain during checkout when purchasing an annual Bluehost hosting plan. Just enter your desired domain name or use AI to generate domain names for you. After checkout, you’ll manage the domain in your Bluehost dashboard. You can also buy extra domains later using Bluehost domain purchase options, keeping your domain and hosting price in one place. HOW DO I ACTIVATE THE FREE SSL CERTIFICATE? Your free SSL certificate (Let’s Encrypt) is included with all hosting plans at Bluehost. Here are steps to activate a free SSL certificate on Bluehost: Log in to your Bluehost Account Manager. From the left menu, click Websites. On the website management page, look for the SSL certificate option. Under the SSL card or Security tab, click Manage. You’ll see the type and status of your SSL listed. Click the vertical ellipsis (⋮) on the right to open more options. From here, you can view SSL logs, generate a CSR or upload an SSL. SSL comes at no extra cost, adding even more value alongside features like Bluehost email hosting and reliable domain and hosting price. WHY DO DIFFERENT HOSTING PLANS COST DIFFERENT AMOUNTS? Bluehost plans vary in price because each package offers different features, storage, performance and support levels. Bluehost Shared hosting has the beginner friendly hosting cost, while VPS and dedicated hosting are higher due to more resources. For example, Bluehost WordPress hosting is optimized for WordPress sites, while Bluehost VPS hosting provides advanced performance. The right plan depends on your website goals and budget. This flexible Bluehost Pricing structure ensures you only pay for the features you need. ARE THERE ANY HIDDEN FEES WITH BLUEHOST HOSTING PLANS? No, there are no hidden fees with Bluehost hosting plans. The hosting cost you see at checkout is what you pay. Optional add-ons, like domain privacy or Bluehost email hosting, may affect your total. But you’ll always know upfront if you choose extras like Bluehost buy domain services. CAN I UPGRADE MY BLUEHOST PLAN LATER? Yes, you can upgrade your Bluehost plan anytime. As your site grows, you can move from shared hosting to Bluehost VPS hosting or even dedicated servers. Upgrading ensures you get more resources without switching providers. This flexibility helps keep your hosting packages aligned with your business needs. DOES BLUEHOST OFFER ECOMMERCE HOSTING? Yes, Bluehost offers eCommerce hosting through optimized WordPress and WooCommerce plans . These plans support secure payments, inventory tools and free SSL. SSL is part of your Bluehost pricing plan, so there’s no hidden cost. With hosting with Bluehost, you get reliable solutions that grow with your business. You can often find a Bluehost discount when signing up for longer terms. For WordPress users selling online, Bluehost’s eCommerce Bundle includes premium tools like YITH plugins, Jetpack, Yoast SEO, and more — at up to 90% off. CAN I BUILD A WEBSITE ON WORDPRESS AND HOST IT WITH BLUEHOST? Yes, you can easily build a WordPress website and host it with Bluehost. We are officially recommended by WordPress.org and offer plans optimized for speed, security and ease of use. With premium hosting services offered by Bluehost, you can avail one-click WordPress installation, automatic updates and a free SSL certificate. Your domain and hosting are bundled for a simple setup and you can enjoy discounts when choosing annual plans. You may also benefit from a Bluehost discount when choosing annual plans. HOW MUCH DOES BLUEHOST CHARGE FOR DOMAIN RENEWAL? Domain renewal costs depend on the extension (.com, .org, etc.). The most Bluehost domain purchase renewals follow standard renewal rates, which can be viewed in your account. If your domain expires, you usually have up to 45 days in the Renewal Grace Period to renew it at the standard domain and hosting price. After that, it may enter a 30-day Redemption Grace Period, where you can still renew but a $99.95 reactivation fee plus the renewal fee associated with the specific domain. Note: Prices are accurate as of September 10, 2025. For the latest updates, please visit Bluehost domain renewal . ARE BACKUPS INCLUDED IN BLUEHOST HOSTING PLANS? Yes, Bluehost provides weekly backups with most plans and you can add advanced backup tools for extra protection. Since backups are part of your hosting package, they help reduce your overall website hosting services cost, as you don’t need a separate backup provider. Advanced users can upgrade to Bluehost’s Security Bundle for automated malware removal, daily backups and enhanced SSL. CAN I CHANGE MY PLANS IF MY CIRCUMSTANCES CHANGE? Yes, you can change your Bluehost plan anytime. If your needs shift, you can upgrade or downgrade to match your budget and resources. This flexibility ensures your hosting cost always fits your situation, whether you’re scaling up or simplifying your website needs. CAN I HOST MULTIPLE WEBSITES ON ONE PLAN OR DO I NEED A SEPARATE PLAN FOR EACH SITE? Yes, Bluehost allows you to host multiple websites under a single hosting plan, specifically through our diverse “High Performance” shared hosting packages . These tiers let you run fully independent websites, each with its own specifications. DO I GET A DISCOUNT IF I PAY ANNUALLY? Yes, Bluehost offers discounted rates when you choose annual or multi-year plans. Paying yearly lowers your overall hosting cost compared to monthly billing. These Bluehost discount options make it easier to manage your budget while getting reliable website hosting services. I'M A PROFESSIONAL WEB DEVELOPER, WHICH IS BETTER FOR ME, WEB HOSTING, CLOUD HOSTING OR VPS HOSTING? For developers, Bluehost VPS hosting or cloud hosting is often better than shared hosting. VPS gives dedicated resources, while cloud hosting offers scalability. Your choice depends on project size and client needs. Standard hosting with Bluehost works for small sites, but advanced options deliver more control and performance. CAN I INSTALL THIRD-PARTY APPLICATIONS ON MY BLUEHOST HOSTING PLAN? Yes, you can use third-party tools like Adobe Dreamweaver or Aloha Editor with your Bluehost plan. The cost of hosting varies by plan, but your website hosting services cost includes support for these applications. For easy file management, we recommend using FTP accounts and consulting the software’s help guides.
